rationale: C12 plausibly supplied the child’s core delegation scaffold: an opening delegation qualified by “Except as otherwise provided,” authority to perform presidential functions “without the approval, ratification, or other action of the President,” a later reservation or exclusion of specified functions, and an identical title 3 definition clause. C07 is also a strong secondary analogue for the child’s scheme of separate service-secretary regulations made uniform and subject to the Secretary of Defense’s approval. C14 closely matches the delegation and definition formulas but lacks C12’s parallel reservation structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Except as otherwise provided in this order, the Secretary of Defense is hereby authorized and empowered to perform, without the approval, ratification, or other action of the President, the functions vested in the President by section 8 ...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Except as otherwise provided in sections 2 and 3 of this order, the Director for Mutual Security is hereby designated and empowered to perform, without the approval, ratification, or other action of the President, the functions vested in the President ...
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive, closely matching opening delegation formula with an exception cross-reference, designated delegate, waiver of further presidential action, and statutory source.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Functions under section 8 of the Act with respect to the selection of a member of the Board of Actuaries ... and the fixing of his compensation are reserved to the President.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There are hereby excluded from the functions delegated by section 1 of this order the functions ... with respect to the termination of assistance.
shared_material.explanation: Both follow the broad opening delegation with a specific presidential reservation or exclusion.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The meaning of the terms "functions" and "perform" as used in this order shall be the same as the meaning of those terms as used in chapter 4 of title 3 of the United States Code.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The meaning of the terms "perform" and "functions" as used in this order shall be the same as the meaning of those terms as used in chapter 4 of title 3 of the United States Code.
shared_material.explanation: Nearly verbatim closing definition clause, differing only in the order of the two defined terms.
